verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships ClawHub, a skills/plugins marketplace with CLI support for search/install/publish/update (openclaw-docs-30, openclaw-docs-94, openclaw-docs-55, openclaw-docs-82), suggesting an ecosystem exists, but there's no evidence of scale (no counts of thousands of skills) or maintainer activity metrics. Concretely undermining the 'genuinely alive and healthy' framing, a 1Password report found the top-ranked skill on ClawHub was a malware installer (openclaw-comm-2), a documented hands-on finding that contradicts the premise of a trustworthy, actively maintained ecosystem. missing for 10: evidence of thousands of published skills, evidence of active third-party maintainers, resolution/response to the malware incident showing ecosystem health.
